'''Movris''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Noonian sector/Legends|Noonian sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].

==History==
It was surmised that a cell of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] support was located there, since [[Foodstuff/Legends|foodstuffs]] stolen from [[Nebula Consumables]] were traced to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]].<ref name="AJ2">{{JournalCite|2|Rebel Privateers!}}</ref>
